title: Toompea Castle
visualBrief: Mapped Toompea compound with pink east and south palace fronts, Baroque central gable, open courts, grey Riigikogu building, limestone western wall, Tall Hermann flag tower, Landskrone and console-mounted Pilsticker.

nativeAxes.origin: Mapped compound center; Y=0 Castle Square attachment plane; western foundations extend to Y=-12

sourceFacts.mapIdentity: relation/3502552 exact Wikidata Q859010; separate named tower and building-part polygons

identityFeatures: Tall Hermann with its broad cylindrical crown and Estonian tricolor
Pink palace with a curved central gable, balcony and three entrance arches
Limestone west curtain and grey courtyard parliament with triangular cornice

reconstruction.basis: Attributed OSM component footprints and heights, Riigikogu architectural descriptions and official exterior photographs
reconstruction.scope: Present-day exterior compound; no room interiors, adjacent cathedral, Governor’s Garden or cliff terrain
reconstruction.referenceState: Three surviving towers; the demolished Stür den Kerl is deliberately absent

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Signed mapped frame; cliff, corner ground datums and real-site contact pending

scaleBasis: Mapped horizontal scale and component height tags. Castle Square is Y=0. Tall Hermann starts at -12m and its stone crown is 33.6m, retaining 45.6m tower height; a reconstructed 12m mast reaches 45.6m above the square. Northern bases -7m/-3m and all inter-part vertical offsets are photographic estimates, not an elevation survey. The published 95m flag elevation is not used as model height.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original reconstruction under repository license. Map-derived plan evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications are linked, not redistributed.
dataAttribution: Footprints © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Riigikogu photographs are linked visual evidence, not redistributed textures or geometry.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Heights tagged in OSM use different local ground levels; reconstructed offsets, roof junctions and northern terrain require geographic review.
The Baroque gable, state arms, triangular ornament and stone corbels are simplified medium-fi geometry. Flags are static geometric tricolors. No navigable interiors.
Synthetic neighbor renders do not verify castle-rock fit, continuous-motion shimmer or physical-device performance.
importReason: Preserve mapped courtyards, the three surviving towers and distinct palace/parliament elevations within the medium-fi budgets.
